info.name: CSVWeave E2E
info.description: End-to-end flows with E2E-TEST data. Run with the Collection Runner or `bin/rails e2e:newman` (FOLDER=Basic or FOLDER=Comprehensive for one scenario). Set the working directory to e2e/fixtures for uploads. See e2e/README.md.
